content:
I can read and understand text in dozens of languages—essentially all major world languages and many smaller ones—as long as the writing uses a script I was trained on (Latin, Cyrillic, Arabic, Devanagari, etc.).

Some examples I handle reasonably well:
- English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch
- Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Czech, Serbian, Croatian, Bulgarian
- Arabic, Persian (Farsi), Urdu
- Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam
- Turkish, Greek, Hebrew
- Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Japanese, Korean
- Indonesian, Malay, Vietnamese, Thai, Filipino/Tagalog

My skill isn’t equal in all of them: I’m strongest in widely used languages with lots of training data, and weaker in very low‑resource or highly specialized dialects. If you tell me which language you care about, I can show you what I can do in it.
